acceptance: docs/conformance/ holds the shared corpus: 11 runnable programs with committed stdout snapshots, 10 diagnostic fixtures with committed expected codes, 8 formatter golden pairs and 3 module cases

The aipo-cli conformance suite runs every fixture through the real pipeline: programs and module entries match their committed stdout, each failure fixture reports its committed diagnostic code (and no unrelated code), and fmt --check never rewrites a file
The fuzz-smoke suite proves no input panics the pipeline: random bytes, mutated programs and truncated programs each yield a diagnostic and exit code 1 or 2
The formatter golden suite proves determinism and idempotency over the corpus, and canonical sources report no drift

docs/conformance/README.md documents the layout, fixture invariants, snapshot matrix, regeneration workflow and the gauntlet rubric; the gate outcome is recorded in docs/evidence/P00-G12-conformance-and-mvp-gate.md

The four canon/implementation gaps the corpus found are recorded, with a minimal demonstrating program each, in docs/adp/ADP-002-construction-hooks-and-runtime-contracts.md and carried as acceptance criteria of P00-G13, so the MVP gate is scored as partial rather than silently closed
cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets, cargo test --workspace and cargo doc --workspace --no-deps are all green
